issues.title: OpenRAC may encounter a very obscure but guaranteed crash from base RaC1
issues.author: TheWhiteGuardian
issues.body:
Hello OpenRAC team! I want to congratulate you all on this amazing project.
I've been messing with the memory of RaC1 for fun, using PCSX2 and RPCS3, for some time now. In doing so I've discovered a quirk about planet Quartu that, under the right circumstances, can guaranteed crash the game. I've tested OpenRAC and it also crashes when it encounters this scenario.

issues.title: Mod SDK: inventory/save hooks and bundled assets for additional weapons
issues.author: noire342
issues.body:
Hi! I'm restoring the cut Revolverator as an additional R&C1 weapon, keeping the original Walloper and using the existing inventory, quick select and HUD.
The preview now installs as a normal native mod on official Windows OpenRAC 0.9.0. It currently bundles an exact-build compatibility layer for missing hooks and read-only asset-manifest aliases. I'd like to replace those with supported SDK facilities so the mod can follow client updates more easily.
